item.title: Teen Mental Health Research Study Opportunity
item.description:
Miami University is conducting a Teenager Emotion Disclosure Study for students in grades 9-12. The study examines how teens talk to caregivers about mental health through a confidential 1-hour online survey. Participants receive $15 for their time. Parent/guardian consent is required. To register or ask questions, contact lead researcher Noelle Marousis at framlab@miamioh.edu. Study approved by Miami University's IRB (#02456r).

item.title: Costa Rica Educational Trip 2027
item.description:
EF Educational Tours is offering Talawanda students an educational trip to Costa Rica in 2027, led by Kari Croucher. Activities include ziplining through rainforests, exploring volcanoes, swimming in thermal hot springs, and snorkeling with sea turtles and manta rays. The next 8 students who enroll by March 27th receive $300 off. Enroll at www.eftours.com/3008612UY - spots are limited.

item.description:

item.title: Spring EOC Testing Schedule and Winter Results
item.description:
Spring EOC Testing Dates: - English Language Arts 2: 3/24 & 3/25 (one part each day) - Algebra & Geometry: 4/21 & 4/22 (one part each day) - Biology: 4/28 (both parts) - American History & Government: 4/29 (both parts)

Students must arrive by 7:40am to locate testing rooms. Testing sessions run 7:55-9:55am on testing days. Non-testers should arrive at 9:55am or report to the cafeteria if arriving earlier. Adjusted bell schedules apply on testing days.

Winter EOC Results Available: Winter EOC state testing results are now accessible in ProgressBook under Assessment Scores > End of Course Assessments. Passing scores: ELA and Algebra 1 require 684+, while Geometry, Biology, American History, and Government require 700+. School counselors will update graduation plans based on scores.

For questions contact Mrs. Hess at HessB@Talawanda.org.

item.title: Senior Timeline - Graduation Events 2026
item.description:
The Senior Class of 2026 graduation timeline includes key dates from April through May. April 21st is the scholarship form deadline (Google Form sent out April 7th) and cap/gown distribution. May 8th is the last regular school day, followed by senior exams May 11-13th. Graduation rehearsal is May 21st at 11:00 AM at THS (must bring cap, gown, and tassel). Commencement is May 21st at 6:30 PM at The Marvin Wilhelm Athletic Complex (arrive by 5:30 PM with cap, gown, and tassel). Gowns are rentals and must be returned after the ceremony. Diplomas available May 27th for those who don't receive them at commencement.
